title: Define planning promotion journal codec
description: Add a strict version-1 .wtp/meta/planning-promote.json contract with prepared and committed states. Store the deterministic selected IDs plus exact before planning paths/bytes and after todo paths/bytes for every record, including status and updatedAt changes. Validate canonical paths remain inside the expected planning/planned and todo directories, targets are unique, snapshots decode to the same identities and allowed statuses, the after set preserves every field except status/updatedAt/lifecycle normalization, and malformed, stale, unknown, duplicate, or path-escaping journals are rejected before replacement. Add deterministic codec, duplicate-property, Unicode, Unix/Windows path, empty-set rejection, and corruption tests.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Tracing the existing strict reusable journal and planning record codecs; implementation will add only the planning-promotion journal contract/tests and preserve all unrelated dirty changes.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented strict v1 planning promotion journal codec and tests. It validates prepared/committed state, non-empty ordered selected IDs/entries, canonical planning/planned and todo targets, exact base64 bytes, strict duplicate/unknown/trailing JSON, snapshot identity/status/field/timestamp invariants, symlink-safe target resolution, stale live-byte preflight, and legal state transition. Focused journal tests and full go test ./... pass; git diff --check passes.
